scenarios.given: A confirmed L2 PortableWorkspace Subsystem has three separable Modules, fixed contracts, independent product and acceptance zones, and sufficient budgets.
scenarios.when: The Phase 3 asynchronous fork, central join and integrated verification vertical slice executes.
scenarios.expected: All current Module groups join deterministically, the immutable integrated Candidate passes Module and Subsystem verification, work_package_completed and subsystem_integrated are independently true, and no routine human checkpoint occurs.

scenarios.given: Three work groups have fixed contracts, disjoint primary writes, mechanically supported isolation and projected benefit greater than total coordination cost.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator evaluates parallel execution.
scenarios.expected: Return parallel_allowed with consumed evidence, reasons, selected mutation mode and projected costs.

scenarios.given: The work is separable but environment, Context, Critic and integration cost exceed expected wall-time savings.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator evaluates net benefit.
scenarios.expected: Return parallel_not_worthwhile and execute serially without weakening any safety or acceptance invariant.

scenarios.given: Two writers need one unresolved logical resource and neither guarded shared containment nor isolated Candidate admission is available.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator evaluates boundary safety.
scenarios.expected: Return parallel_unsafe and use an eligible serial route; prompt instructions cannot authorize parallel writes.

scenarios.given: Parallelization requires changing a public interface not authorized by the Task Specification.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator evaluates the proposed partition.
scenarios.expected: Return needs_human_decision for affected work and preserve unrelated safe progress.

scenarios.given: A planned lane has an exact Work Package, generation, writer, base Candidate, resource digest and mutation mode tuple.
scenarios.when: The Change Guard establishes a boundary for the exact tuple.
scenarios.expected: Return boundary_active before the coordinator marks the lane active or exposes a write-capable driver.

scenarios.given: Boundary provisioning returns a stale generation or a different resource-set digest.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator compares the activation tuple.
scenarios.expected: Keep the lane non-writable and automatically select an approved isolated or serial route, otherwise emit one platform_blocked result.

scenarios.given: A ManifestLoader lane needs one reverse-dependent contract and a bounded source excerpt.
scenarios.when: Its Context Envelope and one purpose-bound increment are materialized.
scenarios.expected: Include only consumed architecture facts and required content, charge the Context budget once, and leave write_authority_changed false.

scenarios.given: A child lane requests the entire Domain without naming a decision question.
scenarios.when: The Context request is evaluated.
scenarios.expected: Return a bounded index or summary, or deny the request; do not inject the Domain contents or expand write scope.

scenarios.given: Product and acceptance writers share fixed expected behavior but have distinct physical and logical resources.
scenarios.when: Both lanes construct their patches asynchronously.
scenarios.expected: Track both as writes, prevent cross-zone mutation, and require independent Test Auditor admission before final use.

scenarios.given: An acceptance patch is admitted before the matching product implementation exists.
scenarios.when: The draft acceptance executes on the current Candidate.
scenarios.expected: Treat RED as provisional evidence, not a test-author failure, then rerun the same acceptance after product integration.

scenarios.given: A child reports all local checks passed and claims the Work Package is complete.
scenarios.when: The coordinator receives the result.
scenarios.expected: Record only candidate_subresult_submitted and wait for central integration and current integrated verification.

scenarios.given: A product lane and acceptance lane both need an approved shared fixture.
scenarios.when: The shared change is scheduled.
scenarios.expected: Assign exactly one active writer, refresh dependent lanes after admission, and allow unrelated lanes to continue.

scenarios.given: A generator source and its outputs span several non-overlapping paths but cannot be verified independently.
scenarios.when: Resource ownership is resolved.
scenarios.expected: Treat the generator and outputs as one logical resource group with a single writer.

scenarios.given: A lane requests a change in another active lane's resource with relevant root-cause evidence.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator evaluates the request.
scenarios.expected: Route, repartition or serialize the change; the request itself grants no write before a new exact generation is active.

scenarios.given: A shared contract admitted by its single owner affects PathNormalizer and ManifestIndex but not ManifestLoader.
scenarios.when: Dependency invalidation is routed.
scenarios.expected: Create new generations and Context increments only for the two dependent groups.

scenarios.given: A writer has useful partial delta and all in-flight mutation state is mechanically known.
scenarios.when: The lane transfers to a replacement writer.
scenarios.expected: Fence and quiesce the old generation, preserve user and Agent deltas, revoke it, then activate a new generation from the current Candidate.

scenarios.given: A writer disappears while an operation may still affect its private or guarded Candidate.
scenarios.when: Handoff safety is evaluated.
scenarios.expected: Return handoff_recovery_required until mutation closure is proven; heartbeat loss and process exit are insufficient.

scenarios.given: The old writer submits a valid-looking patch after its generation was revoked.
scenarios.when: Central admission checks the submission.
scenarios.expected: Return rejected_stale_result and leave the current Candidate unchanged.

scenarios.given: One private patch includes allowed Module edits and one protected root configuration edit.
scenarios.when: Central Patch Admission reconciles actual touched resources.
scenarios.expected: Reject the patch as a whole, preserve it only for bounded rework, and admit no partial delta.

scenarios.given: A patch does not overlap newer content but its dependency closure changed since its base Candidate.
scenarios.when: Freshness admission executes.
scenarios.expected: Return accepted_revalidation_required with a new Candidate identity and no reuse of the old local PASS.

scenarios.given: Two patches pass independently but disagree on a shared state transition after integration.
scenarios.when: Central integration evaluates their combined semantics.
scenarios.expected: Return integration_conflict_rework_required and raise analysis to the Subsystem layer.

scenarios.given: The same patch set produces different content or behavior under two application orders.
scenarios.when: The deterministic integration check executes.
scenarios.expected: Reject the unstable integration rather than selecting the order that happens to pass.

scenarios.given: PathNormalizer and ManifestIndex are ready while ManifestLoader continues bounded repair.
scenarios.when: The Join Barrier reevaluates readiness.
scenarios.expected: Keep early groups waiting with writers stopped and zero Agent cost; do not create a partial Subsystem Candidate.

scenarios.given: All groups claim completion but one product writer remains active.
scenarios.when: Candidate freeze is requested.
scenarios.expected: Return waiting_for_quiescence or recovery_required and create no final Candidate manifest.

scenarios.given: A pre-fence operation is draining and a background writer attempts a new post-fence mutation.
scenarios.when: The Change Guard executes freeze.
scenarios.expected: Drain and reconcile the admitted pre-fence operation, reject the post-fence mutation, then freeze only after complete quiescence.

scenarios.given: The three Module groups finish in many different orders with identical current deltas.
scenarios.when: The Join Barrier integrates them.
scenarios.expected: Use the fixed integration order and produce one identical source snapshot digest.

scenarios.given: All Module groups have local PASS results bound to their private snapshots.
scenarios.when: The integrated Verification Subject is created.
scenarios.expected: Rerun required Module assets on the integrated Candidate, then execute Subsystem scenarios and affected regressions.

scenarios.given: All Module checks pass but the cross-Module deterministic-index scenario fails.
scenarios.when: Failure analysis consumes actual impact facts.
scenarios.expected: Analyze at Subsystem scope, reopen only demonstrated responsible Module lanes, and rerun the current integration closure.

scenarios.given: A current-enough actual-only branch view returns Module dependencies and reverse dependencies.
scenarios.when: The partition plan and Context Envelopes are built.
scenarios.expected: Record the query identity and exact consumed nodes and relations in both downstream artifacts.

scenarios.given: The actual integrated delta reveals a reverse dependent outside the predicted verification closure.
scenarios.when: Pre-join impact reconciliation executes.
scenarios.expected: Expand read and verification closure, report Map drift, and keep write_authority_changed false.

scenarios.given: The System Map is partial for one changed Module while other queried areas are usable.
scenarios.when: The coordinator needs current impact closure.
scenarios.expected: Use bounded live-source discovery only for the partial area and continue automatically when impact becomes known.

scenarios.given: A System Map query ran but the join and completion inputs contain no consumed nodes or relations.
scenarios.when: Completion evaluates impact closure.
scenarios.expected: Reject the impact-complete claim because query invocation without consumption is insufficient.

scenarios.given: The reference Work Package and exact PortableWorkspace Subsystem scenarios pass on the current frozen Candidate.
scenarios.when: Layer completion decisions execute.
scenarios.expected: Evaluate work_package_completed and subsystem_integrated separately and leave domain_accepted and release_candidate not_evaluated.

scenarios.given: A narrower Work Package satisfies its own fixed acceptance but no Subsystem specification was evaluated.
scenarios.when: Completion decisions execute.
scenarios.expected: Allow work_package_completed while subsystem_integrated remains not_evaluated.

scenarios.given: Repeated reciprocal resource requests remove the measured benefit of the active parallel plan.
scenarios.when: The Work Coordinator reevaluates execution.
scenarios.expected: Fence current writers, preserve admitted and useful private delta, and continue through deterministic serial integration without human input.

scenarios.given: The runtime restarts with duplicate, stale and out-of-order lane and admission events.
scenarios.when: Current coordination state is reconstructed from bounded manifests.
scenarios.expected: Restore only current generations, handle duplicates idempotently, reject stale events and avoid duplicate Candidate admission.

scenarios.given: Integrated verification proves that completion requires a repair in a Module outside current write scope.
scenarios.when: Recovery routing evaluates the repair.
scenarios.expected: Preserve Candidate and evidence, emit one structured scope exception and do not grant the outside Module write authority.

scenarios.given: A child lane requests a database, credential, deployment or network operation.
scenarios.when: Execution routing evaluates the request.
scenarios.expected: Return external_high_risk_flow_required and do not execute, retry or treat local ownership as external authority.

scenarios.given: Eight writers submit ten thousand permitted, forbidden, stale, duplicate and shared-resource operations with deterministic seeds.
scenarios.when: Activation, mutation and central admission are exercised in memory.
scenarios.expected: False allow is zero, duplicate admission is zero, unrelated valid lanes are not globally serialized, and retained diagnostics remain bounded.

scenarios.given: Shared-contract changes, invalidations and out-of-order completion events arrive repeatedly across many Module generations.
scenarios.when: The coordinator coalesces events and reevaluates the join.
scenarios.expected: No affected lane is missed, no stale generation joins, and routine event handling consumes zero Agent tokens.

scenarios.given: A large Subsystem has many Module summaries, one slow lane and multiple early-complete lanes.
scenarios.when: Context, waiting and scheduling are measured.
scenarios.expected: No Agent receives whole-Subsystem source by default, early lanes release active resources, and the slow lane remains governed by adaptive timeout and fixed budgets.

scenarios.given: The reference workspace includes required pre-existing user changes equal in content to part of an Agent delta.
scenarios.when: Private Candidates, admission and final manifest are built.
scenarios.expected: User and Agent provenance remain distinguishable, no reset or stash occurs, and the complete functional baseline is preserved.
